context:
Training Gym R63 completed! ALL 4 PASS ON FIRST TRY!

R63 RESULTS (all 10/10, all clean):
1. avl-tree-001 (T9) - AVL Tree with rotations. 4 cases: LL→right, LR→left-right, RR→left, RL→right-left. Delete uses in-order successor.
2. bloom-filter-001 (T8) - Bloom filter with optimal m and k. Double hashing: h1+i*h2. FP rate empirically verified <10%.
3. dp-knapsack-001 (T7) - 0/1 Knapsack 2D DP. Backtrack: if dp[i][w]!=dp[i-1][w], item i-1 was selected.
4. dp-coin-change-001 (T7) - Coin change with reconstruction. Track last_coin[a] for each amount. Backtrack from amount to 0.

DB: 283 exercises, 491 attempts, avg 9.89, 94.7% perfect. 234 passed. Tier 9+ = 62.
29+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.
decisions: AVL: balance_factor = left.height - right.height. If >1: LL or LR. If <-1: RR or RL. Update heights after rotation.
Bloom filter: m = -(n*ln(p))/(ln(2)^2), k = (m/n)*ln(2). Double hashing for k independent hashes.
Knapsack backtrack: walk dp[i][w] from n down. If dp[i][w] != dp[i-1][w], include item i-1, w -= weights[i-1].
Coin change: dp[a] = min over coins c of dp[a-c]+1. Track last_coin[a] = c that gave minimum. Reconstruct backwards.
next_steps: R64: More exercises. Try: Fenwick Tree, Disjoint Set with rollback, or substring matching.
